activity.role: Tragic playwright and author of Medea
activity.notes: The Medea production at the Greater Dionysia in Athens in 431 BCE is a representative authorial event. The historical fifth-century BCE dramatist is not the fictional Medea, the Malifaux character, or the younger Euripides associated with posthumous productions. The mythic Corinth setting is not the author's Polity. Other plays, later Macedonian residence and uncertain biographical anecdotes are not fragmented into unsourced activity rails.
